sql:
WITH RECURSIVE entity_hierarchy AS
(
    SELECT
        EntityKey AS descendant_entity_key,
        EntityKey AS ancestor_entity_key,
        EntityName AS ancestor_entity_name,
        ParentEntityKey
    FROM retail.DimEntity
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        eh.descendant_entity_key,
        p.EntityKey AS ancestor_entity_key,
        p.EntityName AS ancestor_entity_name,
        p.ParentEntityKey
    FROM entity_hierarchy AS eh
    INNER JOIN retail.DimEntity AS p
        ON eh.ParentEntityKey = toFloat64(p.EntityKey)
)
SELECT
    eh.ancestor_entity_key AS EntityKey,
    any(eh.ancestor_entity_name) AS EntityName,
    sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS TotalSalesAmount,
    sum(fs.SalesQuantity) AS TotalSalesQuantity,
    sum(fs.ReturnAmount) AS TotalReturnAmount,
    sum(fs.DiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscountAmount
FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s
    ON fs.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
INNER JOIN entity_hierarchy AS eh
    ON s.EntityKey IS NOT NULL
   AND toInt32(s.EntityKey) = eh.descendant_entity_key
GROUP BY eh.ancestor_entity_key
ORDER BY eh.ancestor_entity_key;
